risks.title: Economic Downturn and Recession
risks.score_rationale: Commercial real estate transaction volume and valuations are cyclical and highly sensitive to economic conditions. A recession would directly reduce property values and transaction activity. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Economic recession could significantly reduce commercial real estate market activity, valuations and transaction volumes, thereby reducing brokerage commissions and financing fees.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Higher interest rates reduce financing activity and property valuations, impacting both financing fee revenue and overall transaction volumes. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Rising interest rates reduce commercial property valuations and financing demand, which could decrease transaction volumes and financing fees.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Commercial real estate brokerage market is competitive with multiple national and regional firms. Market share could be lost to competitors. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intense competition in commercial real estate brokerage could result in loss of market share and pressure on commission rates.

risks.title: Dependence on Independent Contractors
risks.score_rationale: Sales professionals are primarily independent contractors who can terminate relationships and move to competitors, creating retention and revenue risks. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of key investment sales and financing professionals to competitors could significantly impact revenue generation and market position.

risks.title: Credit and Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company has guarantee obligations of $444.9M for loans through strategic alliance. Loan defaults could result in losses. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Guarantee obligations to MTRCC for Fannie Mae loans expose company to potential losses if underlying loans default.

risks.title: Regulatory Changes
risks.score_rationale: Changes in real estate regulations, licensing requirements or securities laws could increase compliance costs. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Regulatory changes in real estate services, securities laws or licensing requirements could increase operational costs and complexity.
